issue: Can a noncitizen petition for review of a standalone CAT order under 8 U.S.C. § 1252(a)(4) without also challenging a final order of removal?

sides.position: No jurisdiction over a standalone CAT claim; the petition must challenge a final order of removal (§ 1252(a)(1)).
cases: Hayles v. U.S. Att'y Gen., 2026 WL 1782580 (11th Cir. 2026)

sides.position: § 1252(a)(4) independently confers jurisdiction to review a CAT claim by petition for review, even without challenging a final removal order.
cases: Laureano v. Att'y Gen. U.S., 177 F.4th 453 (3d Cir. 2026)

quote: And the Third Circuit recently adopted that position, leaving us with a split of authority in the federal circuit courts.
cite: Pierre Riley v. Todd Blanche, No. 22-1609 (4th Cir. 2026)
